decision: BuilderWars is an integration and productization layer for reusable Nymrel assets, not a greenfield rewrite.

adoption_classes.adopt: Use behind a stable contract after exact-version acceptance.
adoption_classes.adapt: Reuse the foundation after BuilderWars-specific implementation and validation.
adoption_classes.reference: Reuse patterns, interfaces, tests, or selected code rather than the complete product.
adoption_classes.hold: Do not inherit production claims until the identified gates are independently satisfied.

components.role: Canonical competition kernel and product source of truth.
components.owner_boundary: Owns competition truth and public match claims.
components.evidence_status: Existing repository behavior and published receipts; preserve historical verifier compatibility.
gates: hosted cross-platform CI remains blocked while GitHub Actions is disabled for the account
external community code requires a stronger independently proven isolation profile

components.role: Portable generic execution and artifact attestation.
components.owner_boundary: Does not replace BuilderWars game-specific adjudication and transcript replay.
components.evidence_status: README-described capabilities; pin an exact commit and run cross-runtime acceptance before adoption.
gates: confirm package distribution paths
define key custody and signer identity policy
map generic proof IDs to BuilderWars receipts without conflation

components.role: Candidate external-entrant and creator-game execution substrate.
components.owner_boundary: Execution controls only; it does not attest model, provider, person, or competitive identity.
components.evidence_status: Promising implementation claims; no BuilderWars production claim may inherit them without exact hostile-host validation.
gates: verify operating-system confinement on supported hosts
prove egress enforcement and bypass resistance
prove CPU memory process and filesystem limits
verify cleanup of descendants and rollback failure semantics
independent security review

components.owner_boundary: Policy enforcement must remain separate from competitive scoring unless the rules explicitly score violations.
components.evidence_status: Requires exact-version contract review and adversarial acceptance.
gates: define BuilderWars permission vocabulary
bind policy versions into match receipts
fail closed on unknown permissions

components.owner_boundary: Administrative authority is not competitive identity or match evidence.
components.evidence_status: Reference pending interface and maturity review.
gates: avoid duplicate permission systems
choose one canonical BuilderWars authority contract

components.role: Agent action and provenance chain patterns.
components.owner_boundary: Must not duplicate the canonical BuilderWars transcript chain or Proof Ledger envelope without a documented composition rule.
gates: identify duplicate primitives
document one receipt-composition model

components.role: Explainable model and execution-route eligibility layer.
components.owner_boundary: Explains routing from caller-supplied facts; it does not certify model or provider identity.
components.evidence_status: Usable foundation after exact adapter and evidence-policy review.
gates: bind resolved model and provider evidence separately
record retries fallbacks errors and repair cost
keep production studio routing separate from public competition policy

components.role: Visual multi-agent roster, topology, intervention, and economics patterns.
components.owner_boundary: A visual roster is not evidence of the exact match roster; receipts remain authoritative.
gates: replace illustrative provider and model claims with bound BuilderWars data
integrate through the canonical entity model

components.role: Candidate team and multi-agent coordination contract.
components.owner_boundary: Competition rules decide what coordination is permitted; the protocol does not decide scoring.
gates: version team coordination contracts
bound communication channels and budgets
prevent undeclared side channels

components.owner_boundary: Transports attention and intervention state, not answers, credentials, or person identity by default.
components.evidence_status: Useful local-first foundation with known identity and WAN gaps.
gates: bind intervention to an authenticated builder or coach
define which games permit intervention
record intervention duration and scope without leaking private input

components.role: Developer-host distribution and MCP entry point.
components.owner_boundary: Discovery and tooling only; the plugin must not adjudicate or silently publish matches.
components.evidence_status: Existing live host bindings; public directory publication remains a separate proof.
gates: define bounded read-only BuilderWars MCP tools first
separate private local execution from hosted public tools
complete host-specific publication evidence

components.owner_boundary: The hub routes tools; it does not become a second competition source of truth.
gates: avoid duplicate MCP production endpoints
choose one canonical hosted tool contract

components.role: Developer showcase and ecosystem information architecture.
components.owner_boundary: BuilderWars owns its product navigation and competition state; the portal may index it.
gates: remove stale or unproven package claims before reuse
align with BuilderWars canonical entities

components.owner_boundary: Structured data reflects accepted BuilderWars records; it does not create evidence.
gates: define BuilderWars JSON-LD vocabulary
avoid unsupported model or provider claims

components.role: Scorecard, badge, remediation, and shareable-audit UI patterns.
components.owner_boundary: Game popularity, quality, and competitive standings require separate dimensions.
components.evidence_status: Reference UI and scoring patterns only.
gates: do not reduce multidimensional competition quality to one misleading score
derive every badge from accepted evidence

components.role: Customer-owned local and open-model execution lane.
components.owner_boundary: Local execution does not independently attest model identity or reproduce stochastic outputs.
gates: bind resolved local model digest and runtime metadata
record fallback use
keep secrets and model weights in customer custody

components.owner_boundary: Cost is one dimension and must not replace acceptance, reliability, or competitive outcome evidence.
gates: use provider-reported and independently reconciled fields
count retries fallbacks and repairs
separate private raw receipts from public aggregates

components.owner_boundary: Commerce must remain downstream of competition integrity, legal review, age and jurisdiction controls, and explicit operator approval.
components.evidence_status: Not part of the initial competition release.
gates: prove demand before adding payment complexity
legal and tax review
separate prizes and entry fees from prohibited gambling mechanics
explicit payment and payout authorization

studio_assets.boundary: Live sports data and rights are separate from immutable fictional replay fixtures.
Reuse generic tournament infrastructure, not customer-specific branding or private data.
builderwars.com becomes canonical only after exact production and redirect verification.
Mobile follows a proven web loop rather than delaying the first release.

integration_rules: BuilderWars owns competition truth, games, rules versions, matches, standings, teams, and public spectator claims.
Proof Ledger may attest generic builds and artifacts but does not replace game-specific replay.
Execution-safety components may be claimed only to the exact controls independently proven on the target host.
Routing components explain selection but do not certify model or provider identity.
Human-intervention systems transport attention and state, not answers or credentials.
Discovery surfaces and plugins never silently adjudicate, rank, publish, or spend.
Every adopted component requires an exact version pin, contract tests, owner, failure semantics, and a documented rollback path.
New work should increase the reusable Nymrel asset base rather than create BuilderWars-only dead ends.
next_required_artifacts: external entrant threat model and host acceptance matrix
